fieldChanges.description: I’m a designer at heart. I work across product design, visual systems, motion, 3D and code.

moduleChanges.text: I studied Communication Design in Mainz after two semesters of Computer Science. I wanted to explore visual language.
I look for the thought that gives the work its direction. I want to make things clear without losing their character.
A decision in one discipline changes what’s possible in another. I use motion, code and AI to turn assumptions into things we can test.
I question the brief, then make something early. A real thing reveals more than a long explanation.
With a working prototype, we can test behaviour and motion together. If an interaction is hard to follow, I can change it in code and test it again.
I set a clear direction and invite collaborators to challenge it while decisions are open. I stay involved through delivery, keeping the central idea visible as the details evolve.
